game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Hidden Spring Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring, a hidden spring: the cave miner must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring: a hidden spring
core_gameplay_loop: In Hidden Spring, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ore lift using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The ore lift reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the ore lift is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how dungeon_clear changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Hidden Spring.
